name: autopilot
description: Drives a Claude Code session toward a goal on its own: rewrites the prompts you type, decides permission asks and questions from the whole conversation, and sends the next instruction after each turn until the goal is done.

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: The model that rewrites the prompts you type: an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id. Permission asks, questions and the next step are decided by the session's own model over the whole conversation.

maxTurns.title: Turn cap
maxTurns.description: The most turns autopilot starts on its own for one goal before it stops and notifies you.

autoEngage.title: Engage in every session
autoEngage.description: Start every session with autopilot on, so the first prompt you type becomes its goal. Off: engage per session with /autopilot.
